about: Acceptance criteria for Copilot 3.3, fixed on 2026-10-17 BEFORE the test split was labelled or any 3.3 detector was run on test drafts. Scored once on the frozen test split (sha256 83ed77d61e17d04a89595e4a2a9644f5cba3742a1da1b7e78cd1c79ae24b8773).

detector_on_test_drafts.layer1_v33_vs_v32: accept the 3.3 Layer 1 changes if recall(v3.3-L1) >= recall(v3.2) and FPR(v3.3-L1) <= FPR(v3.2) + 1 clean item
detector_on_test_drafts.hybrid_vs_layer1: enable the Layer 2+3 hybrid (COPILOT_SEMANTIC_CLAIMS=on) only if, on test: (a) items with errors flagged >= Layer-1 + 3, (b) clean items flagged <= Layer-1 + 1, (c) critical detection >= Layer-1, and (d) the extraction call adds <= 6 s at p95 measured live

final_answers_live.no_more_errors: the share of final answers with a semantic error must not increase vs the 3.2 baseline run on the same test questions
final_answers_live.false_blocks: answers BLOCKED although the draft had no critical error must not increase (count, same questions)
final_answers_live.critical: final answers with a critical error must not increase

note: If (a)-(d) fail, the hybrid ships disabled (code path kept, flag off) and the evaluation reports why.
